edges.reason: msg.sender supplies collateral via safeTransferFrom and is used as the minted perpetual owner

forceClosePerpetuals checks lockTime against block.timestamp before cashing out
lockTime prevents force closing freshly opened perpetuals
msg.sender is the keeper receiving closing and liquidation fees
rewardToken address is used as the callee of the external safeTransfer
owner is looked up from _owners and receives the reward token transfer
_getReward performs rewardToken.safeTransfer, an external call during reward settlement
the reward token transfer triggered by getReward can reenter the contract
_getReward first updates reward accounting through _updateReward
openPerpetual calls _updateReward before storing the perpetual
minting a perpetual triggers the ERC721 receiver check

removeFromPerpetual sends the removed margin via _secureTransfer

forceClosePerpetuals pays owners and keeper via _secureTransfer after all calculations
closePerpetual cashes out the perpetual through _closePerpetual
forceClosePerpetuals cashes out perpetuals through _closePerpetual
_closePerpetual decrements totalHedgeAmount when a perpetual is cashed out
_closePerpetual burns the perpetual and deletes its owner entry
